register.formality: "tú" (informal), the register modern SaaS Spanish UIs (Atlassian, Linear, GitHub) use. Buttons are infinitives (Guardar, Eliminar).
register.note: Neutral international Spanish, no regionalisms (vídeo/video: "video"). Opening ¿ and ¡ are required. A sentence-final ellipsis is "…".
